# Fundamental Physical Constants

| Constant | Symbol | Value | Units (SI) |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| Speed of Light in Vacuum | $c$ | $2.99792458 \times 10^8$ | $\text{m s}^{-1}$ |
| Newtonian Constant of Gravitation | $G$ | $6.67430 \times 10^{-11}$ | $\text{m}^3 \text{kg}^{-1} \text{s}^{-2}$ |
| Planck Constant | $h$ | $6.62607015 \times 10^{-34}$ | $\text{J s}$ |
| Reduced Planck Constant | $\hbar = h/2\pi$ | $1.054571817 \times 10^{-34}$ | $\text{J s}$ |
| Elementary Charge | $e$ | $1.602176634 \times 10^{-19}$ | $\text{C}$ |
| Boltzmann Constant | $k_B$ | $1.380649 \times 10^{-23}$ | $\text{J K}^{-1}$ |
| Avogadro Constant | $N_A$ | $6.02214076 \times 10^{23}$ | $\text{mol}^{-1}$ |
| Ideal Gas Constant | $R = N_A k_B$ | $8.314462618$ | $\text{J mol}^{-1} \text{K}^{-1}$ |
| Vacuum Permittivity | $\epsilon_0$ | $8.85418781 \times 10^{-12}$ | $\text{F m}^{-1}$ |
| Vacuum Permeability | $\mu_0$ | $1.25663706 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{N A}^{-2}$ |

# Particle Masses

| Particle | Symbol | Mass (kg) | Mass (MeV/$c^2$) |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| Electron | $m_e$ | $9.1093837 \times 10^{-31}$ | $0.51099895$ |
| Proton | $m_p$ | $1.67262192 \times 10^{-27}$ | $938.272088$ |
| Neutron | $m_n$ | $1.67492750 \times 10^{-27}$ | $939.565420$ |

# Astronomical and Solar System Data

| Body | Mass (kg) | Equatorial Radius (km) | Mean Orbital Radius (m) | Orbital Period |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sun** | $1.9885 \times 10^{30}$ | $695,700$ | N/A | N/A |
| **Mercury** | $3.3011 \times 10^{23}$ | $2,439.7$ | $5.79 \times 10^{10}$ | $88.0$ days |
| **Venus** | $4.8675 \times 10^{24}$ | $6,051.8$ | $1.08 \times 10^{11}$ | $224.7$ days |
| **Earth** | $5.9724 \times 10^{24}$ | $6,378.1$ | $1.496 \times 10^{11}$ (1 AU) | $365.25$ days |
| **Moon** | $7.342 \times 10^{22}$ | $1,737.4$ | $3.84 \times 10^8$ | $27.3$ days |
| **Mars** | $6.4171 \times 10^{23}$ | $3,389.5$ | $2.28 \times 10^{11}$ | $687.0$ days |
| **Jupiter** | $1.8982 \times 10^{27}$ | $71,492$ | $7.78 \times 10^{11}$ | $11.86$ years |
| **Saturn** | $5.6834 \times 10^{26}$ | $60,268$ | $1.43 \times 10^{12}$ | $29.45$ years |

**Standard Gravity on Earth:** $g = 9.80665 \text{ m/s}^2$

# Conversion Factors

## Energy
*   $1 \text{ eV} = 1.602176634 \times 10^{-19} \text{ J}$
*   $1 \text{ erg} = 10^{-7} \text{ J}$
*   $1 \text{ calorie} = 4.184 \text{ J}$

## Distance
*   $1 \text{ Angstrom (\AA)} = 10^{-10} \text{ m}$
*   $1 \text{ Astronomical Unit (AU)} = 1.495978707 \times 10^{11} \text{ m}$
*   $1 \text{ Light Year (ly)} = 9.4607 \times 10^{15} \text{ m}$
*   $1 \text{ Parsec (pc)} = 3.0857 \times 10^{16} \text{ m} = 3.26 \text{ ly}$

## Pressure
*   $1 \text{ Atmosphere (atm)} = 101,325 \text{ Pa}$
*   $1 \text{ bar} = 100,000 \text{ Pa}$
*   $1 \text{ Torr (mmHg)} = 133.322 \text{ Pa}$
